context_decisions: Keep Contact vs RHP as the batting stat and Get one out! with its explicit count.
Keep the A button in the controller-reconnection prompt.
Free Acquisition Slot belongs to the 2005 draft rules; it is not free agency.
Keep waiver order and the distinct draft rounds versus free-agent selection counts.
Real rookie and free-agent pools enter as groups, not individually.
Spirits-created custom players and fictional draft players remain separate categories.
The historical assignment options bypass participation in the interactive draft/free-agent pool.
Preserve waiting instructions rather than changing an in-progress team selection into a completed signing.
pending: Live menu, draft and free-agency placement, including names at actual rendered widths.
Context coverage for numeric year-duration messages beyond the confirmed calendar routes.
layout_estimate_scope: Comparative Arial 16 px summed-glyph estimates. Both corrected messages retain three rows with at most 32 visible characters and measure below the previous 225 px batch maximum; actual font/widget placement is pending.
